text.p: Swiss starlet Martina Hingis continued her march toward the final of the Australian Open on Thursday, dispatching American Lisa Raymond 6-4 6-2 in the second round.
The 16-year-old, who is hoping to become the youngest ever grand slam winner in the open era of tennis, experienced some difficulty getting the measure of her foe in the first set.
But Hingis soon took control, storming to a 5-2 lead in the second set and taking the match on Raymond's serve with a forehand volley winner to wrap up the match in one hour and three minutes.
Hingis, seeded number four, will next play either Barbara Schett of Austria or Alexandra Fusai of France.
